findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "whatsapp_connect" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Connect a WhatsApp instance. Call this before using other tools. Validates credentials via getStateInstance.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: whatsapp_get_chat_history, whatsapp_get_message, whatsapp_get_qr, whatsapp_last_incoming_messages, whatsapp_last_outgoing_messages, whatsapp_read_chat, whatsapp_receive_notification · Private data: whatsapp_connect, whatsapp_disconnect, whatsapp_get_contact_avatar, whatsapp_get_contact_info, whatsapp_get_contacts, whatsapp_send_contact, whatsapp_send_file, whatsapp_send_file_by_upload, whatsapp_upload_file · Public sink: whatsapp_forward_messages, whatsapp_send_contact, whatsapp_send_file, whatsapp_send_file_by_upload, whatsapp_send_location, whatsapp_send_message, whatsapp_send_poll, whatsapp_upload_file · Destructive: whatsapp_delete_instance, whatsapp_delete_message, whatsapp_delete_notification, whatsapp_disconnect, whatsapp_remove_group_admin, whatsapp_remove_group_participant.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: whatsapp_get_chat_history, whatsapp_get_message, whatsapp_get_qr, whatsapp_last_incoming_messages, whatsapp_last_outgoing_messages, whatsapp_read_chat, whatsapp_receive_notification · Private data: whatsapp_connect, whatsapp_disconnect, whatsapp_get_contact_avatar, whatsapp_get_contact_info, whatsapp_get_contacts, whatsapp_send_contact, whatsapp_send_file, whatsapp_send_file_by_upload, whatsapp_upload_file · Public sink: whatsapp_forward_messages, whatsapp_send_contact, whatsapp_send_file, whatsapp_send_file_by_upload, whatsapp_send_location, whatsapp_send_message, whatsapp_send_poll, whatsapp_upload_file · Destructive: whatsapp_delete_instance, whatsapp_delete_message, whatsapp_delete_notification, whatsapp_disconnect, whatsapp_remove_group_admin, whatsapp_remove_group_participant

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
